title: Privacy Policy
s1p1: The SUJOG platform ("SUJOG"), operated under the Housing & Urban Development Department ("H&UDD"), Government of Odisha, comprises a web-based Portal ("Portal") and Mobile Application ("Mobile App") for citizens of Odisha, authorized officials of Urban Local Bodies (ULBs), Government departments, and associated agencies.
s1p2: SUJOG enables online delivery of urban services through a single-window service delivery channel. These services include Building Permission Approval, Trade License, Property Tax, Water and Sewerage Services, Marriage Registration, Public Grievance Redressal, Layout Approval, Faecal Sludge Management, and other services introduced from time to time. SUJOG is intended to make urban services more accessible, convenient, transparent, and timely for citizens.
s1p3: This Privacy Policy describes how information is collected, used, stored, processed, shared, retained, protected, and disposed of through the SUJOG platform and explains the rights available to users regarding their personal data.
s1p4: Before collecting or processing personal data on the basis of consent, SUJOG shall provide users with a clear and accessible notice describing the personal data collected, the purpose of processing, the manner of exercising user rights, and the grievance redressal mechanism. At registration, service application, or any other relevant stage, users shall be required to provide consent for the collection and processing of their personal data as described in this Privacy Policy. This Privacy Policy may be revised from time to time, and users will be notified of material changes through appropriate channels. Continued use of the System, Portal, or Mobile App after such notification shall be subject to the user's consent to the revised Privacy Policy, wherever required by applicable law.
s2p1: Housing & Urban Development Department (H&UDD), Government of Odisha, is the owner of the SUJOG platform and is responsible for determining the purposes and means of processing personal information collected through SUJOG.
s2p2: The platform may be hosted, maintained, monitored, or supported by authorized Government agencies, technical partners, system integrators, and approved service providers under contractual obligations, confidentiality requirements, and applicable Government policies.
s2p3: All such entities shall process information solely for authorized purposes and in accordance with applicable laws, Government policies, information security standards, and contractual obligations.
s3title: 3. Information Collected and Manner of Collection
s3p1: When a citizen registers on SUJOG, the following information may be collected:
s3p2: When users apply for a specific service, additional information may be collected depending upon the requirements of that service.
s3servicelist: Other service-specific information necessary for processing the requested service
s3p4: The exact information required shall be displayed to the user at the time of submission of the service application.
s3p5: Only such information as is necessary for the provision, verification, processing, administration, monitoring, improvement, or lawful delivery of Government services shall be collected.
s3p6: Registration of Authorized Officials / Staff of Municipalities, State including their associated agencies with the System, either through the Portal or the Mobile App, shall be undertaken centrally by respective entities such as Municipalities for Officials / Staff of Municipalities and Housing and Urban Development Department, Odisha for Officials / Staff of the Department.
s3p7: This registration shall be based on the following information, which shall be submitted by you to the Head of the concerned Municipality / State Department / associated agency and stored securely on a server operated and managed by State Data Centre, Odisha:
s3p8: Login credentials shall be shared with you by the concerned Municipality / State Department / associated agency through the Head of the organization. The list is tentative and may change in future depending on the nature of changes introduced in the System.
s3p9: Information regarding passwords that are generated subsequently by the System, either through the Portal or the Mobile App, utilizing the Forgot Password functionality, shall be stored securely on the SDC Server and shall not be available to any type of user of the System.
s3p10: In case of accessing the System through the Portal, the following additional details will also be collected by the System:
s3portallist: The Internet domain of your service provider and IP address from which you access the website
The type of browser and operating system used to access the site
The date and time you accessed this System
The pages / URLs you have visited in the System
If you reached this System from another Portal / website, the address of the referring Portal / website
s3p11: In case of accessing the System through the Mobile App, the following additional details will also be collected by the System:
s3applist: The Internet domain of your service provider
The date and time you accessed this System
The pages you have visited in the System
s3p12: This information is only used by Housing and Urban Development Department, Odisha to help make the System, Portal and Mobile App more useful for you. With this data, Housing and Urban Development Department, Odisha intends to learn about the frequency of visits by users to the System and the types of technology utilised by users. Housing and Urban Development Department, Odisha never tracks or records information about visits by individual users.
s3p13: Access to information within the System including the Portal and Mobile App is controlled strictly through role-based access control and unauthorised access to information is restricted by the System.
s4p1: Data processed under SUJOG may be classified as follows:
s4p2: Aggregated, anonymised, and non-identifiable datasets may be used for planning, policy making, monitoring, service improvement, statistical reporting, transparency initiatives, and public information purposes.
s4p3: No personally identifiable information shall be disclosed through Open Data.
s5p1: The SUJOG Mobile App may request access to certain device permissions to provide specific functionalities, including:
s5permlist: Location: To enable location-based services, service requests, and geo-tagging of applications.
Camera: To allow users to capture and upload images/documents required for service processing.
Storage/Media: To upload, download, and access files related to service applications.
s5p2: All permissions are requested only when required and are used strictly for delivering the intended services. Users may choose to deny permissions; however, certain features of the App may not function properly.
s5p3: The App requests only permissions necessary for the relevant feature. Location access may include both precise and approximate location and should be used only for service-related location capture, geo-tagging, verification, or delivery of location-based services. Location data shall not be used for advertising or user tracking. Camera and storage/media permissions shall be used only for capturing, uploading, downloading, or accessing files required for service applications. Users may manage permissions through device settings, and denial or revocation of permissions may limit only those features that depend on such permissions.
s6p1: The personal information collected from users under Section 3 above shall be stored securely and used only for lawful, necessary, and proportionate purposes connected with registration, identity verification, service application processing, service delivery, payment or fee reconciliation where applicable, communication, grievance redressal, audit, fraud prevention, security monitoring, statutory reporting, analytics in anonymized or aggregated form, and improvement of Government service delivery.
s6p2: Any photo/picture-based information submitted during the course of availing Services of the System, either through the Portal or the Mobile App, shall be utilized by Authorized Officials / Staff of the Municipality and the State including their associated agencies for scrutiny of application of the requested Service, processing the requested Service, etc.
s6p3: The contact information provided by you shall be used to provide and communicate with you about feedback, follow up on Services for which you have made an application, or queries submitted by you either through the Portal or the Mobile App.
s6p4: The Housing and Urban Development Department, Odisha, is entitled to use your user information collected for the following purposes:
s6uselist: Enforce the legal terms, including but not limited to policies and terms of service, that govern your use of the Services and/or the purposes for which you provided the information.
Prevent fraud or potentially illegal activities, including but not limited to copyright infringement, conducted on or through the System, Portal, Mobile App or Services provided thereunder.

Analyse service usage and platform performance for administrative, statistical, monitoring, reporting, and service-improvement purposes. Any information disclosed externally for such purposes shall be anonymized, aggregated, and non-identifiable.
s6p5: Information collected under Section 3 shall not be used for any purpose incompatible with the purposes described in this Privacy Policy, unless such use is authorised by applicable law, required for performance of a statutory or public function, or based on specific user consent.
s6p6: The data practices described in this Privacy Policy shall be kept consistent with the SUJOG Mobile App's Google Play Data Safety declaration and Apple App Privacy details.
s7p1: Personal information collected through the Portal or Mobile App shall be retained only for as long as necessary for the purposes stated in this Privacy Policy, for the duration of the user's account or service request, and thereafter for such period as may be required under applicable laws, Government record retention requirements, audit requirements, dispute resolution, legal proceedings, public service delivery records, or archival obligations. Where continued retention of identifiable personal information is no longer necessary, the information shall be deleted, de-identified, anonymised, or archived in accordance with applicable Government policies and approved retention schedules. Aggregated or anonymised data that does not identify any individual may be retained for planning, policy, analytics, monitoring, reporting, and service improvement purposes.
s8p1: Subject to applicable law and verification of identity, users may exercise rights in relation to their personal data, including the right to access information about personal data processed through SUJOG, request correction or updating of inaccurate or incomplete information, request erasure of personal data where retention is no longer necessary or legally required, withdraw consent where processing is based on consent, seek grievance redressal, and nominate another person to exercise rights in the event of death or incapacity, where such nomination is supported by applicable law and platform functionality.
s8p2: If a user wishes to cancel registration, withdraw consent, or request deletion of personal information stored on the Server, the user may submit a request through the available Portal, Mobile App, helpdesk, or grievance channel. Such requests shall be processed after verification and subject to legal, statutory, audit, archival, public service delivery, and record retention requirements. Deletion of the Mobile App from a device will delete only information stored locally on that device and will not automatically delete information stored on Government servers.
s9p1: The System, Portal and Mobile App are equipped with standard security features to protect the confidentiality and security of your information. Data is encrypted in transit as well as at rest. Personal information provided at the time of registration is encrypted before being uploaded, where it is stored in a secure, encrypted Server.
s9p2: Personal information that is stored in the Mobile App of other registered users that you come in contact with is securely encrypted and is incapable of being accessed by such user.
s9p3: Sensitive personal data is handled using appropriate security controls and is accessed only by authorised personnel on a need-to-know basis.
s10p1: All data collected under the SUJOG System is stored securely within India, including servers hosted at the State Data Centre (SDC), Odisha, and/or other Government-approved infrastructure located in India. No international transfer of personal data is undertaken unless expressly authorised by applicable law, Government direction, approved contractual safeguards, or user consent where required.
s11p1: This Privacy Policy is accessible through the SUJOG Mobile App and is available publicly on the official website.
s12p1: Personal information may be accessed or disclosed only to authorised officials, Urban Local Bodies, Government departments, associated Government agencies, system administrators, auditors, and security personnel strictly for authorised purposes such as service processing, verification, delivery, grievance redressal, compliance, audit, security, fraud prevention, and lawful Government functions. SUJOG uses third-party services for service-enabling functions such as SMS, email, payment gateway, maps, notifications, analytics, crash reporting, hosting, and OTP; however, personal data is not shared with non-Government vendors or technical partners for independent use, commercial use, advertising, profiling, or tracking. Any service-enabling access shall be limited to what is necessary, governed by approved arrangements, and subject to applicable confidentiality, security, contractual, and legal requirements.
s12p2: No personal data is sold or used for commercial purposes.
s13p1: The SUJOG Mobile App uses third-party or Government-approved service-enabling services for SMS, email, payment gateway, maps, notifications, analytics, crash reporting, hosting, and OTP. These services are used only to support authentication, communication, payment confirmation, service delivery, application processing, technical monitoring, security, and platform reliability. The App does not use third-party advertising SDKs or third-party tracking tools for advertising, profiling, or commercial monetisation. The App's Google Play Data Safety declaration and Apple App Privacy details shall be kept consistent with the actual data collected, shared, linked to users, retained, secured, or used for tracking, if any.
s13p2: If any additional third-party or service-enabling tools are introduced in the future, this Privacy Policy and the applicable Google Play and Apple App privacy disclosures shall be updated accordingly before or at the time such tools are deployed.
s14p1: The SUJOG System is not intended for use by individuals under the age of 18 years. We do not knowingly collect personal information from children.
s15p1: Where personal data is processed on the basis of consent, such consent shall be free, specific, informed, clear, and capable of being withdrawn. Users may withdraw consent through the available Portal, Mobile App, helpdesk, or grievance channel. Withdrawal of consent shall not affect processing already undertaken before withdrawal; however, it may affect the user's ability to access services or features that require the relevant information for lawful service delivery. Where processing is necessary for a statutory, public service, legal, audit, security, or compliance purpose, such processing may continue to the extent permitted by applicable law.
s16p1: In the event of a personal data breach or unauthorised access, disclosure, alteration, loss, or destruction of user data, SUJOG shall take reasonable and prompt measures to contain, investigate, mitigate, and remediate the incident. Where required by applicable law, affected users and competent authorities, including the Data Protection Board of India or other notified authority, shall be informed of the nature of the breach, categories of information affected, likely impact, mitigation steps taken, recommended protective actions, and contact details for further assistance.
